verdict.rationale: Superset lets you clone GitHub repositories through the host's GitHub CLI login and run agents in isolated worktrees and branches on that code. Each workspace's diff viewer supports stage, commit, push and Create PR, and the app has a Pull requests view. Missing for 10: documentation of an agent opening PRs autonomously (PR creation is shown as a user action in the diff viewer), a native GitHub connection that does not depend on a host GitHub CLI login, and independent hands-on corroboration of the GitHub/PR flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect a GitHub repository so an agent can access the code and open pull requests against it

citations.quote: Add your repo from a local folder or clone a remote repository. In the clone dialog, search the GitHub repositories available to the selected host's GitHub CLI login
stage, commit, push, and **Create PR**, all from the diff viewer.
Each agent gets an isolated Git worktree and its own branch.
You review each result in a built-in diff viewer and integrate through ordinary branches and PRs.
